details.eligibility: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university (as per the IBPS Clerk / CRP-CSA notification on ibps.in).
details.pattern: Prelims: 100 questions, 100 marks, 60 minutes (English 30, Quant 35, Reasoning 35). Mains: 190 questions, 200 marks (General/Financial Awareness 50, General English 40, Reasoning & Computer Aptitude 50, Quant 50). No interview.
details.syllabus: Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning Ability, English Language, General/Financial Awareness, Computer Aptitude.
